title: Privacy Policy
intro: This notice explains how NEWRONIQ LTD handles information connected with this website and business enquiries. Contact us about this notice or your personal information using the email below.

sections.heading: Who is responsible
paragraphs: NEWRONIQ LTD is responsible for the personal information it receives through business enquiries. Company registration and registered office details are shown in the footer.

sections.heading: What happens when you use the form
paragraphs: When configured, the embedded Tally enquiry form collects your full name, business email and area of interest. Organisation and a description of the challenge are optional. Submitting the form sends this information to Tally for NEWRONIQ to review and respond. Tally is the authoritative record of form enquiries. If the form is unavailable, you can contact us by email.

The website does not store enquiry answers in its own browser storage or send them to analytics. Only predefined enquiry categories are passed in links. Avoid confidential or sensitive information. Tally may process technical information needed to operate and protect its form.

sections.heading: Why we use enquiry information
paragraphs: We use correspondence to understand your requirements, respond to questions and discuss possible services or product initiatives. An expression of product interest is not a purchase, registration for a live product or subscription to marketing emails.

The relevant lawful basis will depend on the enquiry: taking steps at your request before entering a contract, or our legitimate interests in responding to professional enquiries and managing business relationships. Information needed for legal obligations is handled for that purpose.

sections.heading: Hosting, email and other recipients
paragraphs: GitHub Pages hosts this site and may process technical request information to deliver and protect it. Tally processes submitted enquiries on our behalf and states that form data is stored in Europe. Email alternatives and submission notifications are processed by the relevant email providers.

If optional analytics is configured and you accept, PostHog Cloud EU receives limited interaction events. Providers and their subprocessors may have processing or support arrangements outside the UK. Contact us for information about the arrangements relevant to your enquiry. Relevant information may also be shared with professional advisers or authorities where necessary.

sections.heading: Cookies, fonts and analytics
paragraphs: We ask before enabling optional PostHog analytics. Accepting allows pageviews, advisory CTA clicks, product-interest clicks and confirmed form submission events. We do not send enquiry answers, names, emails or organisations to PostHog, enable session recording or create identified person profiles. Anonymous browser identifiers and technical event information may still constitute personal data.

Rejecting analytics prevents optional PostHog tracking and does not prevent using Tally. Change or withdraw your choice using Analytics Preferences in the footer. We store your preference locally; consented analytics may use browser storage to measure visits. The form is a separate enquiry service, not dependent on analytics consent. No advertising tags or Google Tag Manager are loaded. Fonts are self-hosted.

sections.heading: How long information is needed
paragraphs: Enquiries and related correspondence should be kept only while needed to respond, manage a potential or ongoing business relationship, or meet relevant legal obligations. Retention and deletion criteria depend on the enquiry and whether it progresses into an engagement. Contact us to ask about your records or request deletion; we have not published a fixed retention period. Analytics retention is governed by the configured PostHog project settings.

sections.heading: Your choices and rights
paragraphs: Depending on the circumstances, you may ask to access or correct your personal information, request erasure or restriction, object to processing, or request portability. Where processing relies on consent, you may withdraw it. Some rights are subject to legal exceptions.
Contact us first if you have a concern about your information. You can also complain to the Information Commissioner’s Office (ICO).
